summary: Iteration 14 — Phase A (multi-photo + brand) and Phase B (Discover gender filter). Phase A backend fully verified (4/4 pytest). Phase B frontend fully verified end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844) with buyer@aurafit.demo. Phase A frontend confirmed by code review (all required testIDs present: wizard-brand-input, wizard-photo-grid, COVER badge, photo X/←/→ actions, Next disabled when 0 photos, item-brand uppercase, item-gallery with item-gallery-thumb-N). End-to-end wizard walkthrough was attempted but seller login state across role-tab clicks was flaky in the automated browser; code-level inspection covers the missing checks.
critical_code_review_comments: ItemIn.extra_images uses Pydantic max_length=4. A client sending 5 extras receives 422 (per Pydantic). server-side gallery[:5] cap in routers/items.py still works defensively if the model constraint were relaxed. Behavior matches the stated requirement (server caps to 5 total).
item_to_out synthesizes images=[image_b64] for legacy docs without an images array — back-compat preserved.

success_rate.frontend: Phase B 100% E2E; Phase A code-reviewed (testIDs present, logic correct)

seed_data_creation: Test items prefixed TEST_ created during pytest run, cleaned up in teardown_class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (env var EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not set in shell). For seller auth in Playwright, after tapping 'I already have an account', tap the 'SELLING' role chip BEFORE filling inputs (tapping it after clears the inputs). The seller plus/add-item entry button testID is not present; navigation to /add-item via expo-router programmatic push is the simplest path inside SPA session.
rca_of_issue: n/a — features behave as specified. Phase B Verified: SHOP FOR label present; gender-{all|women|men|unisex|kids} testIDs exist; default 6 category chips (TOPS/DRESSES/BOTTOMS/OUTERWEAR/SHOES/ACCESSORIES); after tapping gender-men, DRESSES disappears, only 5 category chips remain, Editorial Slip Dress is NOT in grid while Selvedge Denim and Tailored Linen Shirt ARE; tapping gender-all restores DRESSES chip and the Slip Dress item. Phase A backend Verified: POST /api/items echoes brand_name; images list contains primary+extras in order; image_b64 equals images[0]; 5-extras payload returns 422 (Pydantic), and 4-extras payload returns a properly capped 5-image gallery; GET /api/items and /api/items/{id} both expose brand_name and images.
